members.name: Tribe 4 (Oct 1)
members.desc: strongly leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); has a time-of-day pattern; leans Up during US stock market open; leans Up when trading volume surge is high. Partly trusts the market price. Only when the market is calm. Needs 2.8¢ of edge to bet.

retired.name: Tribe 1 (Oct 1)
retired.desc: has a time-of-day pattern; bets against the btc move, last 5 min; leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks). Trusts the market price. Only when the market is calm. Needs 4.2¢ of edge to bet.

retired.name: Tribe 5 (Oct 1)
retired.desc: strongly leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); has a time-of-day pattern; fades ETH when it moves first. Partly trusts the market price. Only when the market is calm. Needs 5.1¢ of edge to bet.

retired.name: Tribe 2 (Oct 1)
retired.desc: strongly leans Up when trading volume surge is high; has a time-of-day pattern; leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); fades ETH when it moves first. Trusts the market price. Only when the market is calm. Needs 3.7¢ of edge to bet.
